cands.bio: Democratic member of the Alabama Senate for District 33 (Mobile County) since January 1997, first elected to finish her late husband's term. Former Mobile City Council member (elected 1993) and Senate minority leader. 2008 Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate. Holds a management science degree from the University of New Haven.
cands.gaps: Her birthplace and the year she came to Alabama are not stated in the sources reviewed. We found no documented statements or actions from her on data centers, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, police pay and pensions, gun laws, or school choice and teacher pay. She did not complete Ballotpedia's 2022 or 2026 candidate surveys, so there is no campaign platform in her own words. We found no controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements in the pages reviewed.

qual.background: State senator since 1997 (about 29 years), the first woman to lead a party caucus in either house of the Alabama Legislature as Senate Democratic floor leader from 2012, and a Mobile City Council member elected in 1993.
